title: Listing Add-Ons
description: Manage optional add-ons that providers attach to their listings.

help.title: About Listing add-ons
help.overview: An add-on is an optional extra the buyer can attach when ordering a listing — for example rush delivery or an extra deliverable. It belongs to one listing, carries its own price and optional extra delivery days, and must use the same currency as the order.

sections.title: What you set
items: Name is what the buyer sees at checkout.
Listing and provider are fixed to the offer this add-on extends.
Price amount and currency must match the listing (or package) currency when the order is built.
Delivery days, if set, are added on top of the listing or package delivery window.

sections.title: When it matters
items: Only add-ons that belong to that listing can be selected.
Currency mismatch with the listing or package blocks the order.
Soft-deleted add-ons can be restored; they stop being offerable once deleted.
sections.body: Add-ons are chosen when creating an order from a listing.
